id: \bRyuki: YO! Welcome to my gym. You wouldn't believe it, but we based it off of the gyms in Kanto.
en: \bRyuki: YO! Welcome to my gym. You wouldn't believe it, but we based it off of the gyms in Kanto.
it: \bRyuki: YO! Benvenuto nella mia Palestra. Non ci crederai, ma l'abbiamo ispirata alle Palestre di Kanto.

id: \bWait... you're from Kanto? And not every gym is like this? No matter, we still-
en: \bWait... you're from Kanto? And not every gym is like this? No matter, we still-
it: \bAspetta... vieni da Kanto? E non tutte le Palestre sono così? Non importa, noi comunque-

id: \bAnd they all specialize in only one type, not many? Quiet! I'll show you I'm just as good as the gyms you're used to. Let us begin, my babies!
en: \bAnd they all specialize in only one type, not many? Quiet! I'll show you I'm just as good as the gyms you're used to. Let us begin, my babies!
it: \bE sono tutte specializzate in un solo tipo, non in tanti? Silenzio! Ti dimostrerò che sono bravo quanto le Palestre a cui sei abituato. Cominciamo, piccoli miei!

id: \bRyuki: Woah! You're amazing! Take this reward.
en: \bRyuki: Woah! You're amazing! Take this reward.
it: \bRyuki: Wow! Sei fantastico! Prendi questa ricompensa.

id: \bTM131 contains Dragon Rush. It has a chance to make your opponent flinch.
en: \bTM131 contains Dragon Rush. It has a chance to make your opponent flinch.
it: \bL'MT131 contiene Dragospintone. Può far tentennare l'avversario.

id: \bRyuki: My babies won't lose to you next time!
en: \bRyuki: My babies won't lose to you next time!
it: \bRyuki: La prossima volta i miei piccoli non perderanno contro di te!

id: \bHa! You thought I was just going to let you walk by?
en: \bHa! You thought I was just going to let you walk by?
it: \bAh! Pensavi che ti avrei lasciato passare così?

id: \rYou seem like you know what you're doing.
en: \rYou seem like you know what you're doing.
it: \rSembri uno che sa il fatto suo.

id: \bRyuki uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
en: \bRyuki uses Dragon type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Dragon, Ice, and Fairy types.
it: \bRyuki usa Pokémon di tipo Drago. Sono deboli contro i tipi Drago, Ghiaccio e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
en: \bThey are strong against Dragon. They are resistant to Electric, Fire, Grass, and Water.
it: \bSono forti contro il tipo Drago e resistono ai tipi Elettro, Fuoco, Erba e Acqua.
